rule: Every percentage, count or time used in an answer option, trigger, verdict or value rule. Each is a published figure, a Foundation sample goal adapted by LTM, or an LTM heuristic with its reasoning; the label travels with it into the report's assumption register.

basisValues.foundation_sample_goals_adapted: FinOps Foundation sample goals used as band floors; the adaptation is LTM's
basisValues.published_market_data_as_ceiling: Published survey figure used only as a ceiling
basisValues.ltm_heuristic: LTM heuristic with reasoning; not a market fact

resolvedInconsistencies.cause: The legacy KB mixed the earlier Foundation Walk sample goal (80%) with the current one (85%) [CLM-FIN-035]
resolvedInconsistencies.resolution: One ladder on allocation by cost: more than 90 / 85 / 70% (THR-FIN-01)

resolvedInconsistencies.cause: The legacy KB mixed the earlier Foundation Walk sample goal (about 70%) with the current one (more than 75%) [CLM-FIN-036]
resolvedInconsistencies.resolution: No maturity threshold on coverage; coverage is a value input in quartile bands, with the Foundation goals shown as published context (THR-FIN-02)

thresholds.topic: Allocation coverage (tagging and other allocation rules), measured by cost
thresholds.reasoning: Band floors adopt the FinOps Foundation's current sample goals (about 70% Crawl, 85% Walk, more than 90% Run). Measured by cost, not resource count: tagging is one allocation mechanism alongside account structure and shared-cost rules, so FinOps IQ asks for allocation coverage rather than tag coverage.

supersedes.why: DESIGN.md 3.5 and 14: Foundation example KPIs replace the LTM ladder when found

rule.bands: below 25%, 25-49%, 50-74%, 75% or more, don't know (exact allowed in workshop)
rule.maturity: none: coverage is a value input, not a maturity rating
rule.kpiContext: Foundation sample goals about 60% (Crawl), more than 75% (Walk), more than 80% (Run), shown as published context only

thresholds.reasoning: The right coverage depends on how steady the workload is, so a maturity score on coverage would reward over-commitment. Quartile bands feed LEV-01 and its band corners.

supersedes.why: VALIDATION.md row 24; the two figures are the earlier and current Foundation Walk sample goals

rule.askWhen: eligible coverage unknown or below 50%, or OP-01 at Crawl or below

thresholds.reasoning: An extra question cannot raise a score, so a generous trigger is safe; 50% is a VB-02 band boundary.

rule.numeric: none in v3; utilisation and expiry are assessed as practices (tracked, alerted, renewed by plan)

thresholds.reasoning: No trusted source found for a utilisation percentage per maturity level; the legacy 'more than 95%' and 'more than 98%' figures are withdrawn (VALIDATION.md rows 23, 24).

rule.run: within plus or minus 5% average per quarter

thresholds.reasoning: Band floors adopt the Foundation's current sample goals (under 20% Crawl, under 10% Walk, under 5% Run).

rule.run: automated detection on all accounts, routed to the owner, triaged within one business day
rule.walk: automated detection on major accounts, reviewed at least weekly
rule.crawl: static budget or threshold alerts only

thresholds.reasoning: No Foundation numeric target; consistent with the Foundation's Crawl description (budget alerts, reacting after more than a week) and the earlier hours / days / week-or-more awareness ladder.

rule.crawl: weeks, and the answer is contested

thresholds.reasoning: Mirrors the hours / days / week-or-more awareness ladder (CLM-FIN-038).

thresholds.topic: Client waste hypothesis bands (not scored, never a value input)
thresholds.reasoning: Brackets the published self-estimate (29%) without implying a normal level.

appliesTo: value model: expected and upper cases

rule.aiMaterial: any GPU or model-serving spend, or AI API spend of 5% or more of in-scope spend

rule.rule: at least High when a linked lever's expected net run-rate value is 2% or more of in-scope spend

thresholds.topic: Need verdict bands and urgency thresholds

rule.urgency: value 5% or more of P; growth 20% or more; 25% or more of estate still to move; Tier 2 +10, Tier 3 +20

thresholds.reasoning: FinOps Value Case carry-over, 26-50 band reworded (Q14).
